name: ag-auto-click-scroll
description: Auto-click and auto-scroll for Antigravity IDE, with automatic integration for Antigravity Agent 2.0.

commands.title: AG Auto: Sync & Fix Antigravity Agent 2.0 (Kích hoạt / Sửa lỗi)
AG Auto: Diagnose Antigravity Agent 2.0 (Chẩn đoán)

ag-auto.agentPath.description: Optional Antigravity Agent installation folder or executable path. Leave empty for automatic discovery. Used only for the standalone Agent, not the IDE.

ag-auto.enabled.description: Enable or disable Auto Click and Auto Scroll

ag-auto.language.description: Display language used in the Settings panel

ag-auto.scrollPauseMs.description: Pause duration after a manual scroll action, in milliseconds

ag-auto.clickPatterns.description: List of button labels that can be auto-clicked

ag-auto.pricingConfigUrl.description: Optional public URL for remote pricing JSON (for example a Cloudflare Pages pricing.json file)

ag-auto.autoIntegrateAgent.description: Automatically maintain AG Auto integration for Antigravity Agent 2.0 while the IDE is open. Requires consent; waits for Agent to close and never force-closes it. Turning this off stops automatic maintenance, not the installed Agent runtime.
